comment: What the black sweep leaves alone. py/main_repo_util.py --run-black reads this file through py/repo_util/maintenance_policy.py and applies it to every swept repo except MAM-basics, which formats its own originals: a vendored copy is maintained in its source repo, so reformatting the copy would only make the next sync noisier. global.source_pkg_dirs: each key is a package name that black skips as a directory at any depth, and only the keys are read. overrides: single files copied out of MAM-basics to paths of their own; there are none. foreign_vendored: files copied into a swept repo from a source repo other than MAM-basics. Among the directories the package names cover are MAM-private's copies mgketer/py/mb_cmn and mgketer/py/mb_diff_mpu, made by MAM-private/mgketer/py/main_update_vendored_files.py, and al-hatorah/py/mb_cmn, made by MAM-private/al-hatorah/py/main_update_vendored_files.py, each script copying by intersection with this repo's package of the same name. Nothing measures whether those copies have drifted.
